It prefers loam soils, pH 5.5-7.0, good drainage, and high nitrogen. Drip irrigation, balanced NPK (10-10-10) and organic amendments boost yields of 60-90 t/ha. Major producers include China, India, USA, Turkey, and Egypt. Key challenges are late blight, early blight, Fusarium wilt, and pests like fruit worm, whitefly, and aphids. Proper irrigation, fertilization, timely harvest, and refrigerated storage ensure high-quality marketable fruit.

recommendation.justification: Soil analysis shows nitrogen levels are low, which limits vegetative growth and yield. actions: Perform a quick soil nitrate test to confirm current N levels before application.

Apply the second half of the nitrogen dose 10–14 days later, coinciding with early vegetative growth, and continue drip irrigation at the recommended 20–30 mm week⁻¹.
